<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="id" class="scroll-smooth">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Kedai Pak Moen & Signature Coffee By Tumbbbas</title>
    <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.5.1/css/all.min.css">
    <style>
        @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap');
        body { font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; }
        .no-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
        .no-scrollbar { -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none; }
    </style>
</head>
<body class="bg-stone-50 text-stone-800 antialiased">

    <!-- Navbar -->
    <nav class="sticky top-0 z-40 bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-stone-200">
        <div class="max-w-6xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 h-16 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <div class="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0">
                <div class="w-10 h-10 shrink-0 bg-amber-700 text-white rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xl shadow-sm">
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-mug-hot"></i>
                </div>
                <div class="min-w-0">
                    <h1 id="nav-store-name" class="font-extrabold text-sm sm:text-base text-stone-900 leading-tight truncate">Kedai Pak Moen & Signature Coffee By Tumbbbas</h1>
                    <p class="text-[11px] text-stone-500 truncate">Buka 18.00 – 23.00 WIB (Libur Minggu & Selasa)</p>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 sm:gap-2.5 shrink-0">
                <a id="nav-wa" href="#" target="_blank" class="w-9 h-9 rounded-full bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-600 hover:text-white flex items-center justify-center transition" title="WhatsApp">
                    <i class="fa-brands fa-whatsapp text-lg"></i>
                </a>
                <a id="nav-ig" href="#" target="_blank" class="w-9 h-9 rounded-full bg-pink-50 text-pink-600 hover:bg-pink-600 hover:text-white flex items-center justify-center transition" title="Instagram Kedai Pak Moen">
                    <i class="fa-brands fa-instagram text-lg"></i>
                </a>
                <a id="nav-tt" href="#" target="_blank" class="w-9 h-9 rounded-full bg-stone-100 text-stone-800 hover:bg-stone-900 hover:text-white flex items-center justify-center transition" title="TikTok">
                    <i class="fa-brands fa-tiktok text-base"></i>
                </a>
                <div class="h-6 w-px bg-stone-200 mx-0.5"></div>
                <button onclick="openAdminModal()" class="px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-stone-600 hover:text-amber-700 bg-stone-100 hover:bg-amber-50 rounded-lg transition flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-lock"></i> <span class="hidden md:inline">Admin</span>
                </button>
                <button onclick="toggleCart()" class="relative px-3.5 py-2 bg-amber-700 hover:bg-amber-800 text-white text-sm font-semibold rounded-xl shadow-sm transition flex items-center gap-2">
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-bag-shopping"></i>
                    <span class="hidden sm:inline">Keranjang</span>
                    <span id="cart-badge" class="bg-white text-amber-800 text-xs font-extrabold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full">0</span>
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </nav>

    <!-- Hero Banner -->
    <header class="bg-gradient-to-br from-amber-900 via-stone-900 to-stone-950 text-white py-12 sm:py-16 px-4">
        <div class="max-w-6xl mx-auto flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-8">
            <div class="max-w-xl space-y-4 text-center md:text-left">
                <div class="inline-flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center md:justify-start gap-2">
                    <span class="px-3 py-1 bg-amber-500/20 border border-amber-400/30 text-amber-300 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider rounded-full">
                        <i class="fa-regular fa-clock mr-1"></i> <span id="hero-hours">18.00 – 23.00 WIB • Libur Minggu & Selasa</span>
                    </span>
                </div>
                <h2 id="hero-title" class="text-2xl sm:text-4xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-tight">
                    Kedai Pak Moen & Signature Coffee By Tumbbbas
                </h2>
                <p id="hero-desc" class="text-stone-300 text-sm sm:text-base leading-relaxed">
                    Tempat nongkrong malam nyaman dengan racikan Signature Coffee, camilan hangat, dan menu mengenyangkan. Pesan langsung dari sini dan otomatis terkirim ke WhatsApp!
                </p>
                <div class="pt-2 flex flex-wrap justify-center md:justify-start gap-3">
                    <a href="#menu-section" class="px-6 py-3 bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-500 text-white font-bold rounded-xl shadow-lg shadow-amber-900/40 transition">
                        Lihat Daftar Menu
                    </a>
                    <a id="hero-maps-btn" href="https://maps.app.goo.gl/zw9ocHPsPmeSxgS48" target="_blank" class="px-5 py-3 bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 text-white font-semibold rounded-xl backdrop-blur-sm transition inline-flex items-center gap-2">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-location-dot text-amber-400"></i> Lokasi Toko (Maps)
                    </a>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Info Operasional & Menu Andalan -->
            <div class="w-full max-w-sm bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/15 p-5 rounded-2xl space-y-3.5">
                <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-amber-300 font-semibold">
                    <span><i class="fa-solid fa-fire mr-1"></i> SIGNATURE FAVORIT</span>
                    <span>★ 4.9/5</span>
                </div>
                <div class="flex items-center gap-3.5 bg-stone-900/60 p-3 rounded-xl">
                    <img src="https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1541167760496-1628856ab772?auto=format&fit=crop&w=200&q=80" alt="Tumbbbas Aren Latte" class="w-14 h-14 rounded-lg object-cover shrink-0">
                    <div>
                        <h3 class="font-bold text-white text-sm">Tumbbbas Aren Latte</h3>
                        <p class="text-xs text-stone-400">Kopi susu gula aren signature</p>
                        <p class="text-amber-400 font-bold text-sm mt-0.5">Rp 13.000</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="flex items-center gap-3.5 bg-stone-900/60 p-3 rounded-xl">
                    <img src="https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1536256263959-770b48d82b0a?auto=format&fit=crop&w=200&q=80" alt="Matcha" class="w-14 h-14 rounded-lg object-cover shrink-0">
                    <div>
                        <h3 class="font-bold text-white text-sm">Matcha Signature</h3>
                        <p class="text-xs text-stone-400">Creamy authentic matcha</p>
                        <p class="text-amber-400 font-bold text-sm mt-0.5">Rp 20.000</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="pt-1 border-t border-white/10 flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-stone-300">
                    <span><i class="fa-solid fa-store text-amber-400 mr-1.5"></i>Buka: 18.00 – 23.00 WIB</span>
                    <span class="text-rose-300 font-semibold">Libur: Min & Sel</span>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </header>

    <!-- Menu Section -->
    <main id="menu-section" class="max-w-6xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 py-12">
        <div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 mb-6">
            <div>
                <h2 class="text-2xl font-extrabold text-stone-900">Daftar Menu Kedai</h2>
                <p class="text-sm text-stone-500">Pilih menu favoritmu dan masukkan ke keranjang pesanan</p>
            </div>
            <div class="relative w-full sm:w-72">
                <i class="fa-solid fa-magnifying-glass absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-stone-400 text-sm"></i>
                <input type="text" id="search-input" oninput="renderMenu()" placeholder="Cari kopi, matcha, indomie..." class="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2.5 bg-white border border-stone-200 rounded-xl text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-600">
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Filter Kategori -->
        <div class="flex items-center gap-2 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar pb-4 mb-6">
            <button onclick="setCategory('Semua')" data-cat="Semua" class="cat-btn active px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold bg-amber-700 text-white whitespace-nowrap transition">Semua Menu</button>
            <button onclick="setCategory('Coffee')" data-cat="Coffee" class="cat-btn px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold bg-white text-stone-600 border border-stone-200 hover:bg-stone-100 whitespace-nowrap transition">Coffee</button>
            <button onclick="setCategory('Non Coffee')" data-cat="Non Coffee" class="cat-btn px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold bg-white text-stone-600 border border-stone-200 hover:bg-stone-100 whitespace-nowrap transition">Non Coffee</button>
            <button onclick="setCategory('Snack')" data-cat="Snack" class="cat-btn px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold bg-white text-stone-600 border border-stone-200 hover:bg-stone-100 whitespace-nowrap transition">Snack</button>
            <button onclick="setCategory('Food & Bundling')" data-cat="Food & Bundling" class="cat-btn px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold bg-white text-stone-600 border border-stone-200 hover:bg-stone-100 whitespace-nowrap transition">Food & Bundling</button>
        </div>

        <!-- Grid Menu -->
        <div id="menu-grid" class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
            <!-- Diisi otomatis via JavaScript -->
        </div>
    </main>

    <!-- Lokasi, Jam Operasional & Social Media Section -->
    <section id="social-section" class="bg-white border-t border-stone-200 py-14 px-4 sm:px-6">
        <div class="max-w-6xl mx-auto space-y-10">
            <!-- Baris Info Toko & Lokasi -->
            <div class="bg-amber-50/80 border border-amber-200/80 rounded-2xl p-6 sm:p-8 flex flex-col md:flex-row items-start md:items-center justify-between gap-6">
                <div class="space-y-2">
                    <span class="inline-block px-2.5 py-1 bg-amber-700 text-white text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider rounded-md">Info Lokasi & Jam Buka</span>
                    <h3 class="text-xl font-extrabold text-stone-900">Kedai Pak Moen & Signature Coffee By Tumbbbas</h3>
                    <div class="space-y-1 text-sm text-stone-700 pt-1">
                        <p><i class="fa-regular fa-clock text-amber-700 w-5"></i> <b>Jam Buka:</b> <span id="info-hours">18.00 – 23.00 WIB</span></p>
                        <p><i class="fa-regular fa-calendar-xmark text-rose-600 w-5"></i> <b>Hari Libur:</b> <span id="info-offdays">Minggu & Selasa</span></p>
                        <p><i class="fa-solid fa-location-dot text-amber-700 w-5"></i> <b>Alamat Toko:</b> <span id="info-address">Klik tombol Google Maps di samping untuk rute lokasi tepat toko kami.</span></p>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <a id="info-maps-link" href="https://maps.app.goo.gl/zw9ocHPsPmeSxgS48" target="_blank" class="shrink-0 w-full md:w-auto px-6 py-3.5 bg-amber-700 hover:bg-amber-800 text-white font-bold rounded-xl shadow-sm transition inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-sm">
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-map-location-dot text-lg"></i> Buka di Google Maps
                </a>
            </div>

            <!-- Baris Sosial Media -->
            <div>
                <div class="text-center max-w-xl mx-auto mb-8">
                    <h2 class="text-2xl font-extrabold text-stone-900">Terhubung Dengan Kami</h2>
                    <p class="text-sm text-stone-500 mt-1">Pesan cepat via WhatsApp atau pantau update menu & keseruan kami di Instagram dan TikTok.</p>
                </div>

                <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
                    <!-- Card WhatsApp -->
                    <div class="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-emerald-50/70 border border-emerald-200 flex flex-col justify-between">
                        <div>
                            <div class="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 text-white flex items-center justify-center text-2xl mb-4">
                                <i class="fa-brands fa-whatsapp"></i>
                            </div>
                            <h3 class="font-bold text-lg text-stone-900">WhatsApp Order</h3>
                            <p id="card-wa-num" class="text-xs font-bold text-emerald-700 mt-0.5">+62 882-2568-0856</p>
                            <p class="text-sm text-stone-600 mt-2">Hubungi admin langsung untuk pemesanan, tanya stok menu, atau reservasi tempat.</p>
                        </div>
                        <a id="card-wa-link" href="#" target="_blank" class="mt-6 inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 w-full py-2.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white font-bold rounded-xl text-sm transition">
                            <i class="fa-brands fa-whatsapp"></i> Chat WhatsApp
                        </a>
                    </div>

                    <!-- Card Instagram -->
                    <div class="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-pink-50/70 border border-pink-200 flex flex-col justify-between">
                        <div>
                            <div class="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-tr from-amber-500 via-pink-600 to-purple-600 text-white flex items-center justify-center text-2xl mb-4">
                                <i class="fa-brands fa-instagram"></i>
                            </div>
                            <h3 class="font-bold text-lg text-stone-900">Instagram Official</h3>
                            <p class="text-xs font-bold text-pink-600 mt-0.5"><span id="card-ig-handle">@kedai_pakmoen</span> & <span id="card-ig2-handle">@tumbbbas.coffee</span></p>
                            <p class="text-sm text-stone-600 mt-2">Ikuti kedua akun Instagram kami untuk promo harian, info buka-tutup, dan katalog visual.</p>
                        </div>
                        <div class="mt-6 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                            <a id="card-ig-link" href="#" target="_blank" class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 py-2.5 bg-pink-600 hover:bg-pink-700 text-white font-bold rounded-xl text-xs transition">
                                <i class="fa-brands fa-instagram"></i> @kedai_pakmoen
                            </a>
                            <a id="card-ig2-link" href="#" target="_blank" class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 py-2.5 bg-stone-900 hover:bg-stone-800 text-white font-bold rounded-xl text-xs transition">
                                <i class="fa-brands fa-instagram"></i> @tumbbbas.coffee
                            </a>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <!-- Card TikTok -->
                    <div class="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-stone-100 border border-stone-200 flex flex-col justify-between">
                        <div>
                            <div class="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-stone-900 text-white flex items-center justify-center text-2xl mb-4">
                                <i class="fa-brands fa-tiktok"></i>
                            </div>
                            <h3 class="font-bold text-lg text-stone-900">TikTok Official</h3>
                            <p id="card-tt-handle" class="text-xs font-bold text-stone-700 mt-0.5">@kedai_pakmoen</p>
                            <p class="text-sm text-stone-600 mt-2">Tonton video racikan signature coffee, suasana malam kedai, dan konten seru lainnya.</p>
                        </div>
                        <a id="card-tt-link" href="#" target="_blank" class="mt-6 inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 w-full py-2.5 bg-stone-900 hover:bg-stone-800 text-white font-bold rounded-xl text-sm transition">
                            <i class="fa-brands fa-tiktok"></i> Buka TikTok
                        </a>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </section>

    <!-- Footer -->
    <footer class="bg-stone-950 text-stone-400 py-8 px-4 text-center text-xs space-y-1">
        <p id="footer-copy" class="font-semibold text-stone-300">© 2026 Kedai Pak Moen & Signature Coffee By Tumbbbas.</p>
        <p>Buka Pukul 18.00 – 23.00 WIB • Libur Hari Minggu & Selasa</p>
    </footer>

    <!-- Floating WhatsApp Button -->
    <a id="float-wa" href="#" target="_blank" class="fixed bottom-5 right-5 z-30 w-14 h-14 bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-600 text-white rounded-full shadow-xl flex items-center justify-center text-3xl transition transform hover:scale-105" title="Hubungi WhatsApp">
        <i class="fa-brands fa-whatsapp"></i>
    </a>

    <!-- Drawer Keranjang Belanja -->
    <div id="cart-drawer" class="fixed inset-0 z-50 hidden">
        <div onclick="toggleCart()" class="absolute inset-0 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-xs"></div>
        <div class="absolute right-0 top-0 bottom-0 w-full max-w-md bg-white shadow-2xl flex flex-col">
            <div class="p-5 border-b border-stone-200 flex items-center justify-between">
                <h3 class="font-extrabold text-lg text-stone-900"><i class="fa-solid fa-bag-shopping text-amber-700 mr-2"></i>Keranjang Pesanan</h3>
                <button onclick="toggleCart()" class="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-stone-100 hover:bg-stone-200 flex items-center justify-center text-stone-600">
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-xmark"></i>
                </button>
            </div>

            <div id="cart-items" class="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-5 space-y-3">
                <!-- Item keranjang -->
            </div>

            <div class="p-5 border-t border-stone-200 bg-stone-50 space-y-3">
                <div class="flex justify-between items-center font-bold text-base">
                    <span>Total Pembayaran</span>
                    <span id="cart-total" class="text-amber-700 text-lg">Rp 0</span>
                </div>

                <div class="space-y-2 pt-1">
                    <input type="text" id="cust-name" placeholder="Nama Pemesan *" class="w-full px-3.5 py-2 bg-white border border-stone-300 rounded-xl text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-600">
                    <select id="cust-type" class="w-full px-3.5 py-2 bg-white border border-stone-300 rounded-xl text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-600">
                        <option value="Dine-In (Makan di Tempat)">Dine-In (Makan di Tempat)</option>
                        <option value="Takeaway (Bawa Pulang)">Takeaway (Bawa Pulang)</option>
                        <option value="Delivery (Pesan Antar)">Delivery (Pesan Antar)</option>
                    </select>
                    <input type="text" id="cust-note" placeholder="Nomor meja / alamat / level gula/es (opsional)" class="w-full px-3.5 py-2 bg-white border border-stone-300 rounded-xl text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-600">
                </div>

                <button onclick="checkoutWhatsApp()" class="w-full py-3 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white font-bold rounded-xl shadow-md transition flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                    <i class="fa-brands fa-whatsapp text-lg"></i> Pesan Sekarang via WhatsApp
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Modal Panel Admin & Database -->
    <div id="admin-modal" class="fixed inset-0 z-50 hidden">
        <div onclick="closeAdminModal()" class="absolute inset-0 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs"></div>
        <div class="relative max-w-4xl mx-auto my-6 bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col max-h-[90vh]">
            <div class="p-5 bg-stone-900 text-white flex items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                    <h3 class="font-extrabold text-lg">Panel Admin & Database Kedai</h3>
                    <p class="text-xs text-stone-400">Kelola menu, riwayat pesanan, jam buka, dan tautan media sosial</p>
                </div>
                <button onclick="closeAdminModal()" class="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 flex items-center justify-center">
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-xmark"></i>
                </button>
            </div>

            <!-- Login PIN Screen -->
            <div id="admin-login-view" class="p-10 text-center max-w-sm mx-auto space-y-4">
                <div class="w-14 h-14 bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center text-2xl mx-auto">
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-shield-halved"></i>
                </div>
                <h4 class="font-bold text-lg">Masukkan PIN Admin</h4>
                <p class="text-xs text-stone-500">Gunakan PIN default: <b>1234</b></p>
                <input type="password" id="admin-pin-input" placeholder="••••" class="w-full text-center tracking-widest text-xl font-bold px-4 py-2.5 border border-stone-300 rounded-xl">
                <button onclick="verifyAdminPin()" class="w-full py-2.5 bg-amber-700 hover:bg-amber-800 text-white font-bold rounded-xl">Masuk Dashboard</button>
            </div>

            <!-- Dashboard Admin View -->
            <div id="admin-dashboard-view" class="hidden flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-5 space-y-6">
                <!-- Tabs -->
                <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2 border-b border-stone-200 pb-3">
                    <button onclick="switchAdminTab('orders')" id="tab-orders" class="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold bg-amber-700 text-white">Riwayat Pesanan (<span id="order-count">0</span>)</button>
                    <button onclick="switchAdminTab('menus')" id="tab-menus" class="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold bg-stone-100 text-stone-700">Kelola Menu</button>
                    <button onclick="switchAdminTab('settings')" id="tab-settings" class="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold bg-stone-100 text-stone-700">Info Toko & Sosmed</button>
                </div>

                <!-- Tab 1: Pesanan -->
                <div id="panel-orders" class="space-y-3">
                    <div class="flex justify-between items-center">
                        <h4 class="font-bold text-sm">Database Pesanan Masuk</h4>
                        <button onclick="clearOrders()" class="text-xs text-red-600 hover:underline">Hapus Semua Riwayat</button>
                    </div>
                    <div id="admin-orders-list" class="space-y-2.5"></div>
                </div>

                <!-- Tab 2: Kelola Menu -->
                <div id="panel-menus" class="hidden space-y-4">
                    <form onsubmit="addMenuItem(event)" class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-5 gap-2.5 bg-stone-50 p-4 rounded-xl border border-stone-200">
                        <input type="text" id="new-menu-name" required placeholder="Nama Menu" class="px-3 py-2 bg-white border rounded-lg text-xs">
                        <select id="new-menu-cat" class="px-3 py-2 bg-white border rounded-lg text-xs">
                            <option value="Coffee">Coffee</option>
                            <option value="Non Coffee">Non Coffee</option>
                            <option value="Snack">Snack</option>
                            <option value="Food & Bundling">Food & Bundling</option>
                        </select>
                        <input type="number" id="new-menu-price" required placeholder="Harga (Rp)" class="px-3 py-2 bg-white border rounded-lg text-xs">
                        <input type="url" id="new-menu-img" placeholder="URL Gambar (opsional)" class="px-3 py-2 bg-white border rounded-lg text-xs">
                        <button type="submit" class="py-2 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white font-bold rounded-lg text-xs">+ Tambah Menu</button>
                    </form>
                    <div id="admin-menu-list" class="divide-y border rounded-xl overflow-hidden"></div>
                </div>

                <!-- Tab 3: Pengaturan Toko & Sosmed -->
                <div id="panel-settings" class="hidden space-y-3.5 max-w-lg">
                    <div>
                        <label class="block text-xs font-bold mb-1">Nama Kedai</label>
                        <input type="text" id="set-store-name" class="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg text-sm">
                    </div>
                    <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                        <div>
                            <label class="block text-xs font-bold mb-1">Jam Buka</label>
                            <input type="text" id="set-hours" class="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg text-sm">
                        </div>
                        <div>
                            <label class="block text-xs font-bold mb-1">Hari Libur</label>
                            <input type="text" id="set-offdays" class="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg text-sm">
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                        <label class="block text-xs font-bold mb-1">Link Google Maps Toko</label>
                        <input type="url" id="set-maps" class="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg text-sm">
                    </div>
                    <div>
                        <label class="block text-xs font-bold mb-1">Nomor WhatsApp Admin (diawali 62)</label>
                        <input type="text" id="set-wa" class="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg text-sm">
                    </div>
                    <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                        <div>
                            <label class="block text-xs font-bold mb-1">Instagram Kedai (tanpa @)</label>
                            <input type="text" id="set-ig" class="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg text-sm">
                        </div>
                        <div>
                            <label class="block text-xs font-bold mb-1">Instagram Coffee (tanpa @)</label>
                            <input type="text" id="set-ig2" class="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg text-sm">
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                        <label class="block text-xs font-bold mb-1">Username TikTok (tanpa @)</label>
                        <input type="text" id="set-tt" class="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg text-sm">
                    </div>
                    <button onclick="saveSettings()" class="px-5 py-2.5 bg-amber-700 hover:bg-amber-800 text-white font-bold rounded-xl text-sm">Simpan Pengaturan</button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        // --- DATABASE LOKAL (Default Data Kedai Pak Moen & Signature Coffee By Tumbbbas) ---
        const DEFAULT_SETTINGS = {
            storeName: "Kedai Pak Moen & Signature Coffee By Tumbbbas",
            hours: "18.00 – 23.00 WIB",
            offDays: "Minggu & Selasa",
            mapsUrl: "https://maps.app.goo.gl/zw9ocHPsPmeSxgS48",
            wa: "6288225680856",
            ig: "kedai_pakmoen",
            ig2: "tumbbbas.coffee",
            tt: "kedai_pakmoen"
        };

        const DEFAULT_MENUS = [
            // Coffee
            { id: 1, name: "Tumbbbas Aren Latte", category: "Coffee", price: 13000, desc: "Perpaduan espresso pilihan dengan gula aren murni dan susu creamy.", img: "https://mediaedukasi.id/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/kopi-susu-gula-aren-inilah-risiko-jika-dikonsumsi-berlebihan.jpg" },
            { id: 2, name: "Tumbbbas Creamy Aren", category: "Coffee", price: 15000, desc: "Ekstra creamy dengan racikan spesial gula aren signature Tumbbbas.", img: "https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcRwlFxVrGO7-8VU2NhqPUbx_9dkVkEFiBoolhfs2QHuQg&s=10" },
            { id: 3, name: "Tumbbbas Butterscotch", category: "Coffee", price: 18000, desc: "Kopi susu lembut dengan aroma dan rasa karamel butterscotch gurih manis.", img: "https://inforadar.disway.id/upload/bb18b63e012b5321ccb660be83beb4e5.jpeg" },
            { id: 4, name: "Indonesiano", category: "Coffee", price: 8000, desc: "Kopi hitam klasik segar dari biji kopi pilihan Nusantara.", img: "https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcTev1L1OzYH6ij_awQfYdzeavBzl55DXzh7GVa1DjTdkS94xdD6BF6sAs0&s=10" },

            // Non Coffee
            { id: 5, name: "Matcha", category: "Non Coffee", price: 20000, desc: "Minuman green tea matcha pekat dan creamy yang menyegarkan.", img: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1536256263959-770b48d82b0a?auto=format&fit=crop&w=500&q=80" },
            { id: 6, name: "Coklat Signature", category: "Non Coffee", price: 15000, desc: "Racikan cokelat premium pekat, manis pas dan lembut di tenggorokan.", img: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1542990253-0d0f5be5f0ed?auto=format&fit=crop&w=500&q=80" },

            // Snack
            { id: 7, name: "Kentang Goreng", category: "Snack", price: 10000, desc: "French fries renyah gurih disajikan hangat dengan saus pilihan.", img: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1576107232684-1279f390859f?auto=format&fit=crop&w=500&q=80" },
            { id: 8, name: "Sosis Goreng", category: "Snack", price: 15000, desc: "Sosis pilihan digoreng garing di luar dan juicy di dalam.", img: "data:image/jpeg;base64," },
            { id: 9, name: "Cireng Isi", category: "Snack", price: 10000, desc: "Cireng renyah kenyal dengan isian gurih nikmat.", img: "data:image/jpeg;base64," },
            { id: 10, name: "Warm Soft Cookies (per pcs)", category: "Snack", price: 4000, desc: "Soft baked cookies hangat dengan lelehan cokelat di setiap gigitan.", img: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1499636136210-6f4ee915583e?auto=format&fit=crop&w=500&q=80" },
            { id: 11, name: "Warm Soft Bread", category: "Snack", price: 5000, desc: "Roti lembut disajikan hangat, teman pas pendamping kopi.", img: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1509440159596-0249088772ff?auto=format&fit=crop&w=500&q=80" },

            // Food & Bundling
            {
                id: 12,
                name: "Paket Indomie Kedai",
                category: "Food & Bundling",
                price: 10000,
                desc: "Pilih varian Indomie hangat favoritmu (Indomie Telor / Indomie + Nasi / Paket Komplit).",
                img: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1612929633738-8fe44f7ec841?auto=format&fit=crop&w=500&q=80",
                variants: [
                    { name: "Indomie Telor", price: 10000 },
                    { name: "Indomie + Nasi", price: 12000 },
                    { name: "Indomie + Telor + Nasi", price: 17000 }
                ]
            },
            { id: 13, name: "Kentangtingtung (Kentang Sosis Cireng)", category: "Food & Bundling", price: 30000, desc: "Paket platter komplit berisi Kentang Goreng, Sosis Goreng, dan Cireng Isi untuk sharing.", img: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1561758033-d89a9ad46330?auto=format&fit=crop&w=500&q=80" },
            { id: 14, name: "Rice Bowl Telur", category: "Food & Bundling", price: 12000, desc: "Nasi hangat pulen dengan olahan telur spesial bumbu gurih kedai.", img: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1512058564366-18510be2db19?auto=format&fit=crop&w=500&q=80" },
            { id: 15, name: "Rice Cooker", category: "Food & Bundling", price: 1000000, desc: "Menu spesial / unit Rice Cooker Kedai Pak Moen.", img: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1544025162-d76694265947?auto=format&fit=crop&w=500&q=80" }
        ];

        // Gunakan key baru v2 agar data terbaru Kedai Pak Moen langsung termuat
        let settings = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('pakmoen_settings_v5')) || DEFAULT_SETTINGS;
        let menus = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('pakmoen_menus_v5')) || DEFAULT_MENUS;
        let orders = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('pakmoen_orders_v5')) || [];
        let cart = [];
        let currentCategory = 'Semua';

        const formatRupiah = (num) => 'Rp ' + Number(num).toLocaleString('id-ID');

        // --- INISIALISASI TAMPILAN ---
        function applySettings() {
            document.title = `${settings.storeName} - Menu & Pemesanan`;
            document.getElementById('nav-store-name').innerText = settings.storeName;
            document.getElementById('hero-title').innerText = settings.storeName;
            document.getElementById('hero-hours').innerText = `${settings.hours} • Libur ${settings.offDays}`;
            document.getElementById('info-hours').innerText = settings.hours;
            document.getElementById('info-offdays').innerText = settings.offDays;
            document.getElementById('footer-copy').innerText = `© 2026 ${settings.storeName}.`;

            const waUrl = `https://wa.me/${settings.wa}`;
            const igUrl = `https://instagram.com/${settings.ig}`;
            const ig2Url = `https://instagram.com/${settings.ig2}`;
            const ttUrl = `https://tiktok.com/@${settings.tt}`;

            document.getElementById('nav-wa').href = waUrl;
            document.getElementById('nav-ig').href = igUrl;
            document.getElementById('nav-tt').href = ttUrl;
            document.getElementById('float-wa').href = waUrl;
            document.getElementById('hero-maps-btn').href = settings.mapsUrl;
            document.getElementById('info-maps-link').href = settings.mapsUrl;

            document.getElementById('card-wa-link').href = waUrl;
            document.getElementById('card-ig-link').href = igUrl;
            document.getElementById('card-ig2-link').href = ig2Url;
            document.getElementById('card-tt-link').href = ttUrl;

            document.getElementById('card-ig-handle').innerText = `@${settings.ig}`;
            document.getElementById('card-ig2-handle').innerText = `@${settings.ig2}`;
            document.getElementById('card-tt-handle').innerText = `@${settings.tt}`;
        }

        function setCategory(cat) {
            currentCategory = cat;
            document.querySelectorAll('.cat-btn').forEach(btn => {
                if (btn.dataset.cat === cat) {
                    btn.className = "cat-btn active px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold bg-amber-700 text-white whitespace-nowrap transition";
                } else {
                    btn.className = "cat-btn px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold bg-white text-stone-600 border border-stone-200 hover:bg-stone-100 whitespace-nowrap transition";
                }
            });
            renderMenu();
        }

        function renderMenu() {
            const keyword = document.getElementById('search-input').value.toLowerCase();
            const grid = document.getElementById('menu-grid');
            const filtered = menus.filter(item => {
                const matchCat = currentCategory === 'Semua' || item.category === currentCategory;
                const matchVariant = item.variants && item.variants.some(v => v.name.toLowerCase().includes(keyword));
                const matchKey = item.name.toLowerCase().includes(keyword) || (item.desc && item.desc.toLowerCase().includes(keyword)) || matchVariant;
                return matchCat && matchKey;
            });

            if (filtered.length === 0) {
                grid.innerHTML = `<div class="col-span-full text-center py-12 text-stone-400">Menu tidak ditemukan.</div>`;
                return;
            }

            grid.innerHTML = filtered.map(item => {
                // Jika menu memiliki tabel varian (seperti Paket Indomie)
                if (item.variants && item.variants.length > 0) {
                    return `
                    <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-amber-300 overflow-hidden shadow-xs hover:shadow-md transition flex flex-col sm:col-span-2 lg:col-span-1">
                        <div class="relative h-44 bg-stone-100">
                            <img src="${item.img}" alt="${item.name}" class="w-full h-full object-cover">
                            <span class="absolute top-3 left-3 px-2.5 py-1 bg-amber-700 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-lg shadow-xs">${item.category}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="p-5 flex-1 flex flex-col justify-between">
                            <div>
                                <h3 class="font-bold text-lg text-stone-900">${item.name}</h3>
                                <p class="text-xs text-stone-500 mt-1 mb-3">${item.desc}</p>
                                <!-- Tabel Varian -->
                                <div class="border border-stone-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden text-xs">
                                    <table class="w-full text-left border-collapse">
                                        <thead class="bg-stone-100 text-stone-700 font-bold">
                                            <tr>
                                                <th class="py-2 px-2.5">Varian</th>
                                                <th class="py-2 px-2">Harga</th>
                                                <th class="py-2 px-2 text-right">Pilih</th>
                                            </tr>
                                        </thead>
                                        <tbody class="divide-y divide-stone-200">
                                            ${item.variants.map((v, vIdx) => `
                                                <tr class="hover:bg-amber-50/50">
                                                    <td class="py-2 px-2.5 font-semibold text-stone-800">${v.name}</td>
                                                    <td class="py-2 px-2 font-bold text-amber-700">${formatRupiah(v.price)}</td>
                                                    <td class="py-2 px-2 text-right">
                                                        <button onclick="addVariantToCart(${item.id}, ${vIdx})" class="px-2.5 py-1 bg-stone-900 hover:bg-amber-700 text-white font-bold rounded-lg transition">
                                                            +
                                                        </button>
                                                    </td>
                                                </tr>
                                            `).join('')}
                                        </tbody>
                                    </table>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    `;
                }

                // Menu standar
                return `
                <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-stone-200 overflow-hidden shadow-xs hover:shadow-md transition flex flex-col">
                    <div class="relative h-44 bg-stone-100">
                        <img src="${item.img || 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1509042239860-f550ce710b93?auto=format&fit=crop&w=500&q=80'}" alt="${item.name}" class="w-full h-full object-cover">
                        <span class="absolute top-3 left-3 px-2.5 py-1 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-xs text-stone-800 text-xs font-bold rounded-lg shadow-xs">${item.category}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="p-5 flex-1 flex flex-col justify-between">
                        <div>
                            <h3 class="font-bold text-lg text-stone-900">${item.name}</h3>
                            <p class="text-xs text-stone-500 mt-1 line-clamp-2">${item.desc || 'Menu pilihan terbaik dari kedai kami.'}</p>
                        </div>
                        <div class="mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-stone-100 flex items-center justify-between">
                            <span class="font-extrabold text-amber-700 text-base">${formatRupiah(item.price)}</span>
                            <button onclick="addToCart(${item.id})" class="px-3.5 py-2 bg-stone-900 hover:bg-amber-700 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-xl transition flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-plus"></i> Tambah
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                `;
            }).join('');
        }

        // --- KERANJANG & CHECKOUT WHATSAPP ---
        function addToCart(id) {
            const item = menus.find(m => m.id === id);
            const cartKey = `menu-${id}`;
            const existing = cart.find(c => c.cartKey === cartKey);
            if (existing) {
                existing.qty += 1;
            } else {
                cart.push({ cartKey, id: item.id, name: item.name, price: item.price, qty: 1 });
            }
            updateCartUI();
        }

        function addVariantToCart(id, variantIdx) {
            const item = menus.find(m => m.id === id);
            const variant = item.variants[variantIdx];
            const cartKey = `menu-${id}-var-${variantIdx}`;
            const existing = cart.find(c => c.cartKey === cartKey);
            if (existing) {
                existing.qty += 1;
            } else {
                cart.push({ cartKey, id: item.id, name: variant.name, price: variant.price, qty: 1 });
            }
            updateCartUI();
        }

        function changeQty(cartKey, delta) {
            const idx = cart.findIndex(c => c.cartKey === cartKey);
            if (idx > -1) {
                cart[idx].qty += delta;
                if (cart[idx].qty <= 0) cart.splice(idx, 1);
            }
            updateCartUI();
        }

        function updateCartUI() {
            const totalQty = cart.reduce((sum, i) => sum + i.qty, 0);
            const totalPrice = cart.reduce((sum, i) => sum + (i.price * i.qty), 0);
            document.getElementById('cart-badge').innerText = totalQty;
            document.getElementById('cart-total').innerText = formatRupiah(totalPrice);

            const container = document.getElementById('cart-items');
            if (cart.length === 0) {
                container.innerHTML = `<div class="text-center py-12 text-stone-400 text-sm">Keranjang masih kosong.<br>Silakan pilih menu terlebih dahulu.</div>`;
                return;
            }

            container.innerHTML = cart.map(item => `
                <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 p-3 bg-stone-50 rounded-xl border border-stone-200">
                    <div class="flex-1">
                        <h4 class="font-bold text-sm text-stone-900">${item.name}</h4>
                        <p class="text-xs text-amber-700 font-semibold">${formatRupiah(item.price)}</p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <button onclick="changeQty('${item.cartKey}', -1)" class="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-white border border-stone-300 font-bold text-xs">-</button>
                        <span class="text-sm font-bold w-5 text-center">${item.qty}</span>
                        <button onclick="changeQty('${item.cartKey}', 1)" class="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-white border border-stone-300 font-bold text-xs">+</button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `).join('');
        }

        function toggleCart() {
            document.getElementById('cart-drawer').classList.toggle('hidden');
        }

        function checkoutWhatsApp() {
            if (cart.length === 0) return alert('Keranjang masih kosong!');
            const name = document.getElementById('cust-name').value.trim();
            if (!name) return alert('Mohon isi Nama Pemesan terlebih dahulu.');

            const type = document.getElementById('cust-type').value;
            const note = document.getElementById('cust-note').value.trim() || '-';
            const total = cart.reduce((sum, i) => sum + (i.price * i.qty), 0);

            // Simpan ke database pesanan lokal
            const newOrder = {
                id: 'ORD-' + Date.now().toString().slice(-5),
                time: new Date().toLocaleString('id-ID'),
                customer: name,
                type,
                note,
                items: [...cart],
                total
            };
            orders.unshift(newOrder);
            localStorage.setItem('pakmoen_orders_v5', JSON.stringify(orders));

            // Format pesan WhatsApp
            let text = `Halo *${settings.storeName}*, saya mau pesan:

`;
            text += `*ID Pesanan:* ${newOrder.id}
`;
            text += `*Nama:* ${name}
`;
            text += `*Tipe:* ${type}
`;
            text += `*Catatan/Meja:* ${note}

`;
            text += `*Detail Pesanan:*
`;
            cart.forEach((item, idx) => {
                text += `${idx + 1}. ${item.name} (${item.qty}x) = ${formatRupiah(item.price * item.qty)}
`;
            });
            text += `
*Total Pembayaran: ${formatRupiah(total)}*
Terima kasih!`;

            const url = `https://wa.me/${settings.wa}?text=${encodeURIComponent(text)}`;
            cart = [];
            updateCartUI();
            toggleCart();
            window.open(url, '_blank');
        }

        // --- PANEL ADMIN ---
        function openAdminModal() {
            document.getElementById('admin-modal').classList.remove('hidden');
        }

        function closeAdminModal() {
            document.getElementById('admin-modal').classList.add('hidden');
        }

        function verifyAdminPin() {
            const pin = document.getElementById('admin-pin-input').value;
            if (pin === '171026') {
                document.getElementById('admin-login-view').classList.add('hidden');
                document.getElementById('admin-dashboard-view').classList.remove('hidden');
                renderAdminData();
            } else {
                alert('PIN salah! Gunakan ****');
            }
        }

        function switchAdminTab(tab) {
            ['orders', 'menus', 'settings'].forEach(t => {
                document.getElementById('panel-' + t).classList.add('hidden');
                document.getElementById('tab-' + t).className = "px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold bg-stone-100 text-stone-700";
            });
            document.getElementById('panel-' + tab).classList.remove('hidden');
            document.getElementById('tab-' + tab).className = "px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold bg-amber-700 text-white";
        }

        function renderAdminData() {
            document.getElementById('order-count').innerText = orders.length;
            const orderList = document.getElementById('admin-orders-list');
            orderList.innerHTML = orders.length === 0
                ? `<p class="text-xs text-stone-400">Belum ada pesanan masuk.</p>`
                : orders.map(o => `
                    <div class="p-3.5 border rounded-xl bg-stone-50 text-xs space-y-1">
                        <div class="flex justify-between font-bold text-stone-900">
                            <span>${o.id} • ${o.customer} (${o.type})</span>
                            <span class="text-amber-700">${formatRupiah(o.total)}</span>
                        </div>
                        <p class="text-stone-500">${o.time} • Catatan: ${o.note}</p>
                        <p class="text-stone-700 pt-1">${o.items.map(i => `${i.name} (${i.qty}x)`).join(', ')}</p>
                    </div>
                `).join('');

            const menuList = document.getElementById('admin-menu-list');
            menuList.innerHTML = menus.map(m => `
                <div class="p-3 flex items-center justify-between bg-white text-xs">
                    <div>
                        <span class="font-bold text-stone-900">${m.name}</span>
                        <span class="ml-2 px-2 py-0.5 bg-stone-100 rounded text-stone-600">${m.category}</span>
                        <span class="ml-2 font-bold text-amber-700">${m.variants ? 'Multi-Varian (Mulai ' + formatRupiah(m.price) + ')' : formatRupiah(m.price)}</span>
                    </div>
                    <button onclick="deleteMenu(${m.id})" class="text-red-600 hover:underline font-semibold">Hapus</button>
                </div>
            `).join('');

            document.getElementById('set-store-name').value = settings.storeName;
            document.getElementById('set-hours').value = settings.hours;
            document.getElementById('set-offdays').value = settings.offDays;
            document.getElementById('set-maps').value = settings.mapsUrl;
            document.getElementById('set-wa').value = settings.wa;
            document.getElementById('set-ig').value = settings.ig;
            document.getElementById('set-ig2').value = settings.ig2;
            document.getElementById('set-tt').value = settings.tt;
        }

        function addMenuItem(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const newItem = {
                id: Date.now(),
                name: document.getElementById('new-menu-name').value,
                category: document.getElementById('new-menu-cat').value,
                price: Number(document.getElementById('new-menu-price').value),
                img: document.getElementById('new-menu-img').value,
                desc: "Menu baru pilihan spesial dari kedai kami."
            };
            menus.push(newItem);
            localStorage.setItem('pakmoen_menus_v5', JSON.stringify(menus));
            e.target.reset();
            renderMenu();
            renderAdminData();
        }

        function deleteMenu(id) {
            menus = menus.filter(m => m.id !== id);
            localStorage.setItem('pakmoen_menus_v5', JSON.stringify(menus));
            renderMenu();
            renderAdminData();
        }

        function clearOrders() {
            if (!confirm('Hapus semua riwayat pesanan?')) return;
            orders = [];
            localStorage.setItem('pakmoen_orders_v5', JSON.stringify(orders));
            renderAdminData();
        }

        function saveSettings() {
            settings = {
                storeName: document.getElementById('set-store-name').value.trim() || DEFAULT_SETTINGS.storeName,
                hours: document.getElementById('set-hours').value.trim() || DEFAULT_SETTINGS.hours,
                offDays: document.getElementById('set-offdays').value.trim() || DEFAULT_SETTINGS.offDays,
                mapsUrl: document.getElementById('set-maps').value.trim() || DEFAULT_SETTINGS.mapsUrl,
                wa: document.getElementById('set-wa').value.trim() || DEFAULT_SETTINGS.wa,
                ig: document.getElementById('set-ig').value.trim().replace('@', '') || DEFAULT_SETTINGS.ig,
                ig2: document.getElementById('set-ig2').value.trim().replace('@', '') || DEFAULT_SETTINGS.ig2,
                tt: document.getElementById('set-tt').value.trim().replace('@', '') || DEFAULT_SETTINGS.tt
            };
            localStorage.setItem('pakmoen_settings_v5', JSON.stringify(settings));
            applySettings();
            alert('Pengaturan berhasil disimpan!');
        }

        // Jalankan saat halaman dimuat
        applySettings();
        renderMenu();
        updateCartUI();
    </script>
</body>
</html>
